blockers.summary: Mainline qcom_scm uses QCOM_SCM_SMCINVOKE_INVOKE (0x02, fnid 0x0602); stock SM8150 uses SMCINVOKE_INVOKE_CMD 0x32000600 (fnid 0x0600). qcom_scm_qtee_init only checks -EIO and does not fall back to QCOM_SCM_SMCINVOKE_INVOKE_LEGACY.
blockers.action: Run the passive gate-0 check on the current boot. If no /sys/bus/platform/devices/qcomtee* exists, gate 0 fails as shipped. A legacy-probe fallback is a separate secure-world experiment and was not added.

blockers.summary: QCOMTEE=m builds a module with a platform:qcomtee modalias. qcom_scm registers the platform device at boot, so udev/systemd can autoload and bind qcomtee.ko; qcomtee_probe() then issues a QTEE feature/version query. Compiling =m does not load it, but the configuration is not passive on a normal udev system.
blockers.action: For a passive gate-0 check, omit qcomtee.ko from the installed modules tree or boot with module_blacklist=qcomtee, then load it manually only for the deliberate test. Do not describe QCOMTEE=m alone as passive.

blockers.summary: No phone, boot, sensor power/reset, IRQ count, HBM or HAL test was performed. No fingerprint authentication is claimed.
